config.directives.description: List of afio command-line directives (as strings) to be written as-is in the configuration file. Each item corresponds to one line in the output config file. Variables are embedded via Jinja2 placeholders like -o {{ archive }} etc., but in this case, we store full directive strings in the list to allow maximum flexibility and fidelity to real afio syntax. Since afio is CLI-based, the config file is a list of arguments, not key-value pairs. Every variable used in the template appears here as a list of strings, and we do not nest objects; each directive is a plain string item in the list.
